description:
Outcome: Review the first-version phone journeys, from brief.md / Constraints and owner map deferral.
Scope: Owner inspects A's fictional-data prototype: sign-in, application, allocation lists/forms, own status and reporting. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Question: Are these journeys understandable and usable on a phone? Record the owner's decision on large text, plain language, labels, focus and keyboard operation.
Behaviour: Include loading, empty, validation, retry and expired-link screens. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Recorded owner prototype review; dependent UI awaits this checkpoint. Prerequisites: T-001. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover. Stage-1 limitation: checkpoint is an ordinary ticket and approval is not mechanically enforced.
title: Checkpoint: phone prototype
